change: InfoProviders.collect now performs a live-target check before invoking each provider callback, in addition to the existing post-callback backing identity/liveness check.
rationale: Prevents later installed callbacks from running after an earlier callback invalidates or unloads the target.
Preserves no-force-load behavior; the guard only observes server-thread, dimension, entity identity/removal, chunk-loaded, and block-entity identity state.
next_step: Inspect push-triggered exact-source verification; then run independent installed optional-provider fixture with callback revocation, entity/block unload or replacement, and explicit no-force-load evidence.
